Original sophisticated watercolor and gouache editorial illustration, restrained rich colors, subtle paper texture, realistic adult proportions, no cute mascots. Lower 57% warm cream reading panel with refined DARK NAVY serif typography, generous margins and comfortable LARGE text. All text must fit fully, exceptionally readable. No Korean or other captions, logos, watermarks, recognizable existing characters, real brands, or artist imitation. Only one complete card, no mockup or border cropping.
